interpretation: External repetition edit changes some completed decimal answers, including a prohibited loss. Presentation gain is not strict-comparison or complete-family transfer and cannot qualify zero-regression adaptation.

patch_receipt_replay.scope: Before values and source tensor identity remain hash-bound host measurements; this analysis does not load the original model.

presentation_gain_interval.estimand: Paired target presentation-accuracy change, not strict-comparison or complete-family accuracy
presentation_gain_interval.method: Exploratory percentile bootstrap over underlying target families; all eight correlated renderings stay together
presentation_gain_interval.scope: Six designed families do not establish population-level improvement. This interval does not qualify a candidate or remove observed regressions.

scope: External published repetition intervention under our short greedy decimal endpoint. Not a reproduction of MATH-500, GSM8K, IFEval or long sampled thinking-mode benchmarks; not evidence that WeightBridge discovered or learned a decimal rule.

strict_comparison_gain_interval.estimand: Paired strict-comparison accuracy change, clustered by underlying family
strict_comparison_gain_interval.scope: Degenerate observed zero changes do not establish zero population uncertainty.

update_norms.relative_norm_scope: The two full modified matrices, not total-model parameter fraction or Track A norm authorization
